title: Bob Jahn from Boeing plasma physics to the Princeton PEAR lab

tellings.quote: there's a guy named Bob John who was a plasma physicist who worked at Boeing who then went on to run the Princeton pair lab the parasychology lab.

plain: A plasma physicist named Bob Jahn worked at Boeing and then went on to run the PEAR lab (Princeton Engineering Anomalies Research), a lab at Princeton University that studied parapsychology. Michels mentions this himself, without a source, as an example of a hard scientist turning to the paranormal.
